answer: A convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is small time-locked deposits: every agent identity must post a stake that stays locked for one epoch, and it is refunded only after the agent behaves honestly through that epoch. Fake identities must each lock real capital for the full duration, so an attacker flooding the economy with thousands of sybils freezes its funds like a tundra while earning nothing, and any misbehavior during the epoch burns the deposit at its nadir of value.
